title: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
title_original: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 7 (Reporting on Livestock Numbers, etc.) Special Self-Governing Mayor, Special Self-Governing Governor, Mayor, County Executive, District Mayor (referring to the mayor of a self-governing district) shall, in accordance with Article 8(6) of the Act, designate the following individuals as the subjects of reporting, and the content of the report shall include, for each livestock farmer, the type of livestock, farm name, representative's name, address, contact information, and the number of livestock raised. <Amended June 29, 2012, December 23, 2015>
1. An agricultural worker as defined in Article 3(2) of the "Agricultural, Rural, and Food Industry Basic Act"
2. Any person raising livestock for sale
